sloka: सर्वे भवन्तस् तिष्ठन्तु महाराजेन सम्गताः ।अहम् एको हनिष्यामि राघवम् सह लक्ष्मणम् ॥६-८-२०॥।।
transliteration: sarve bhavantas tiṣṭhantu mahārājena samgatāḥ ।aham eko haniṣyāmi rāghavam saha lakṣmaṇam ॥6-8-20॥।।

translations.english: "Let all of you stay here along with the king. Going alone I will kill Rama along with Lakshmana, and Hanuman also Sugriva and all of the Vanaras."
